projects.title: ArcheroHub
projects.description: ArcheroHub ( www.archerohub.com ) was a web application that acted as a matchmaking queue for the mobile game Archero. It assisted players in finding co-op or pvp matches. The application was developed using ReactJS and Firebase as the backend.

projects.title: HUBG
projects.description:
HUBG was a web application that displayed aggregated stats for players of the game PUBG. The web application allowed players to search up themselves or other players to see lifetime stats, season stats, match reports, and a complete breakdown of weapon usage and stats. The application was featured by the developer of PUBG and had an article written, which no longer exists but can be seen on archive.org (https://web.archive.org/web/20201109041928/https://www.pubg.com/2018/10/15/featured-apps-spotlight-hubg/). 

HUBG was developed using ReactJS for the front end and falcon for the web server and microservices.
